newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler to restart idled plants by Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler to restart idled plants by Tuesday.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Friday that all North American production facilities idled by the now-settled strike at its Mound Road Engine plant will be operating again by Tuesday.

Earlier Friday, members of United Auto Workers Local 51 voted to ratify a new local labor contract for the Detroit plant by an overwhelming margin. Chrysler said Mound Road machining division operators would begin returning to work on Satuday, and the plant's full workforce would be back Monday.

Chrysler will resume assembly operations on Monday at the Conner Avenue Viper plant in Detroit; the Pillette Road van plant in Windsor, Ont.; and at truck plants in St. Louis, Warren, Mich., and Saltillo and Lago Alberto, Mexico.
Skilled trades workers will return to the job on Monday at Chrysler's Jefferson North Jeep plant in Detroit, but the plant's full workforce will not return until Tuesday.
Chrysler said it will resume stamping operations in Sterling Heights and Warren, Mich., on Monday.
Also on Monday, workers would return to idled components plants in Detroit; Dayton, Ohio; Ajax and Etobicoke, Ontario; Huntsville, Ala.; New Castle, Ind.; and Toledo, Ohio.
